exposure: class I obese with large-for-gestational-age and gestational diabetes
class II obese with additional diagnoses of a large-for-gestational-age fetus or pregnancy complicated by gestational diabetes
Implementation of an obesity protocol for delivery by estimated due date
cohort: 5000 randomly selected women who delivered at Geisinger between January 2009 and September 2013 (excluding 2011)
finding: Implementation of a maternal-fetal medicine obesity protocol, which recommended delivery by estimated due date for certain obese women, did not increase but rather decreased the rate of cesarean deliveries in this group.
mod_finding: Implementation of a maternal-fetal medicine obesity protocol did not increase the rate of cesarean deliveries in obese women.
